# gyro_container_notifications (Resource)

Alert channels of a Gyro Containers (ECS) environment: e-mail, SMS, Telegram (chat id from the platform bot), signed webhook. Events: down, crashloop, replicas_low (per-service threshold: gyro_container_service.notification.min_ready), scale_max, capacity. An event is announced after ~2 minutes, at most once per `cooldown` minutes per service and event, with a resolved message. Destroy = defaults (e-mail on, others off).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Alert channels of a Gyro Containers (ECS) environment.
resource "gyro_container_notifications" "alerts" {
  service_id  = 123
  email       = true
  sms         = false
  telegram    = "123456789" # send /start to @gyrouptime_bot, it replies with your chat id
  webhook_url = "https://ops.example.com/gyro-alerts"
  events      = ["down", "crashloop", "replicas_low", "scale_max", "capacity"]
  cooldown    = 30
}

# Verify webhooks: X-Gyro-Signature = "sha256=" + HMAC-SHA256(secret, X-Gyro-Timestamp + "." + body)
output "webhook_secret" {
  value     = gyro_container_notifications.alerts.webhook_secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_id` (Number) Container environment (service) id.

### Optional

- `cooldown` (Number) Minutes between two announcements of the same service + event (5-1440).
- `email` (Boolean) Account e-mail.
- `events` (Set of String) Enabled events (default all): down, crashloop, replicas_low, scale_max, capacity.
- `resolved` (Boolean) Send a resolved message.
- `sms` (Boolean) Account phone (SMS).
- `telegram` (String) Telegram chat id (send /start to the platform bot).
- `webhook_url` (String) https URL of a public server (JSON POST, X-Gyro-Signature).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `webhook_secret` (String, Sensitive) Signing secret: X-Gyro-Signature = sha256=HMAC(secret, X-Gyro-Timestamp + "." + body).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
# <service_id>
terraform import gyro_container_notifications.alerts 123
```
